historical_representation: A text alone, frozen prior vectors; B only diagnostic
queries: exact byte copy of prior30 queries

selection.base: prior240 immutable unit IDs and vectors
selection.extra_frame: local verified rag_full full space, all ordinals
selection.method: NumPy PCG64(seed17892019) permutation of1..N; skip protected240; deterministic query-independent prefix
selection.reason: Different answers of a parent are distinct units; one-per-parent would cap below1M and change the target population. Count repeated parents explicitly.

lexical.method: same BM25 French Snowball as prior audit

global: take topL per method on global population; RRF contribution only for branch retrieval
distributed_global_ranks: take topL per corpus per branch, union; same global IDF/scores; RRF uses ORIGINAL GLOBAL branch ranks, never per-corpus ranks or compressed pool ranks; no final quotas
distributed_caveat: exact global ranks available as experimental oracle; not assumed cheaply obtainable by independent remote indexes
witnesses: all existing historical query-passage judgments grade>=2, unmodified; annotated0/1 kept as contrasts
qualitative_pool: union top10 lexical,vector,globalRRF50,globalRRF1000,distributedRRF50 at240 and1M; add stratified overtaking contemporary witnesses for case analysis if needed; prior grades immutable

resource_policy.db: only unix local, read-only, no schema/index writes
